analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript describe a data lake and analytics pipeline at Veritiv. First, sales data at the invoice level stored in an on-premises database is ingested via VPN and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) using CDC into Amazon Redshift. Second, order flat files from the ERP system land in an S3 drop bucket, which triggers SQS messaging. SQS launches Initiator Lambda (Lambda 1), which retrieves file metadata from DynamoDB and populates the S3 Data Lake (raw and refined buckets). Third, S3 bucket event triggers launch Complex Processing Lambda (Lambda 2), which merges order sales and inventory sales, applies Python statistical models for demand forecasting, writes refined files back to the Data Lake, and loads processed demand data into Redshift. Finally, Redshift and Data Lake are queried for analytics and business reporting. The connection ledger contains 11 visual connections, and exactly 11 edges are emitted across logical workflows.
